claim_one_line: IN THE FRAME THE LEPTONS ALWAYS SHARE THE DOWN QUARKS' HIERARCHY EXPONENTS, AND THE LEVEL ONLY CHANGES AN ORDER-ONE FACTOR (PROVED, data-free; card sealed before the runs; P-862 step 2): the coupling depends on a sector only through its charges times the point, so Y_lep(tau, w) = Y_(-1,2)(tau, 3w) exactly, the down sector with the doublet's sign negated; the cusp exponents ignore that sign, so e_lep(alpha) = e_down(3 alpha) on every slope, and at every level not divisible by 3 the lepton and down exponents coincide (at levels divisible by 3 the leptons see the down exponents of order N/3); the order-one factor between the levels' averaged second-generation ratios is 1 at order 5, and at order 10 tends to 0.6346 or its reciprocal 1.5757 by reading (constant in Im tau, shifting 3e-4 with Re tau through the held end), the first generation unsplit; that constant is the down sector's own ratio between its two readings, a cusp-limit relation only (the bulk differs by 6 to 25 %). Three selection-free relations, one per level; by main's disclosed recall each is expected to fail against the known lepton-down split, and none is compared here. 0 of 19.
